nodes.name: Rasterizer
nodes.responsibility: Admits one job at a time, starts a browser only when there is work, and retires one that failed a capture

nodes.name: Raster session
nodes.responsibility: Draws one SVG at a time in the page it opened: writes the file, loads it, proves the page ready, sets the scale and shoots

nodes.name: Chromium launch
nodes.responsibility: Starts one Chromium, connects to it, opens pages and exact-size windows, and stops it with proof the group and root are gone

nodes.name: DevTools connection
nodes.responsibility: One socket to a target: its calls and events, the page's last complaints, and a Blob streamed into a file

nodes.name: Chromium
nodes.responsibility: The browser that paints the SVG, runs the recording page and answers over DevTools

nodes.name: Headless browser
nodes.responsibility: The one place archboard starts a browser of its own: private, reachable only over loopback DevTools, and proved gone

nodes.name: Chromium executable
nodes.responsibility: Which Chromium to run, spawning it in its own group and temp root, and making that whole group go away

nodes.name: Walkthrough recorder
nodes.responsibility: Starts the browser a recording needs, opens the page at 1920x1080, and moves the file into place only once that browser has stopped

spawn in its own group and temp root
spawn, read the port, stop the group
connect the browser and each page
evaluate in the page, stream its Blob
